## Overview

The architecture of KAT-Coder-Pro V2 is designed to handle a wide range of tasks, including text generation, coding, analysis, and more. With its robust capabilities, this model is poised to be a valuable tool for developers looking to integrate advanced language processing into their applications.

Kwaipilot: KAT-Coder-Pro V2 boasts an impressive set of technical specifications. It has a context window of 256,000 tokens, allowing it to process and understand large amounts of text. In terms of pricing, the model costs $0.3 per 1M tokens for input and $1.2 per 1M tokens for output. Its capabilities include text, function calling, JSON mode, streaming, and structured outputs, making it a versatile tool for various use cases.
